style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Candy Cane Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Deck your halls with a twist of holiday fun! This 160cm candy cane garland is bursting with festive flair, featuring charming red and white candy cane accents, pops of bright berries and pinecones, and lush greenery that brings your décor to life. It’s the perfect blend of whimsical nostalgia and joyful colour—ready to make any space feel merry and bright. Drape it along your mantel, wrap it around your staircase, or frame your door with a sprinkle of sweetness—this garland makes every corner of your home feel like a winter wonderland straight out of a holiday movie. Garland Length: L160cm. Matching items available. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
